d.ko: The young girl Rayne, who became the sacred knight of the kingdom, was entrusted by Jas, the leader of the sacred knights and her lover, to investigate the disturbances occurring in a distant town named "Hakudeti".
d.en: The young girl Rayne, who became the sacred knight of the kingdom, was entrusted by Jas, the leader of the sacred knights and her lover, to investigate the disturbances occurring in a distant town named "Hakudeti".
d.zh:
年少有为的王国圣骑士少女蕾，在圣骑士长兼恋人贾斯的命令下，
来到遥远的城镇调查突发的异变事件。

这次的异变，导致和平的城镇增加了许多罪犯，
甚至出现了迷之地下城，涌现了大量的魔物。
